connection.title: Execution
connection.description: Run this project's agent tasks on a runner through a connected bot.
connection.empty: No bot is connected. Connect a bot to run this project's agent tasks on a runner.
connection.forbidden: Only workspace owners and admins can manage this project's execution settings.

bot.label: Bot
bot.noneConnected: No bot of this workspace is connected yet
bot.name: Bot name

runner.shared: Shared by every project this bot serves

error.urlInvalid: Enter the runner's address, starting with http:// or https://.
error.dirAbsolute: Enter an absolute path, such as /home/you/work/project.
error.dirSegments: The path must not contain . or .. segments or //.
error.veto: Veto requires level Vetoer or Autonomous.
error.domainChoose: Choose a domain and a level.

block.title: Copy this configuration now
block.body: It contains the bot's token and the signing secret. Sylvode does not keep a copy and cannot show it again. Put it in the runner's configuration file and restart the runner.
block.label: Runner configuration (sylvode-runner.toml)
block.copyFailed: Copy failed; select the text and copy it
block.doneReason: Confirm that you stored the configuration
block.leave: Leave without saving the runner configuration? It cannot be shown again.
block.lost: Lost the configuration? Rotate credentials to get a new one.
block.scope: This bot can act only in projects it is connected to.

connection.connectedNoChange: Connected. No change is needed on the runner; make sure {directory} is inside its allowed_roots.

runner.label: Runner
runner.waitingHint: Waiting for the runner to use the new configuration.
runner.protocolMismatch: The runner speaks another task protocol than this server.

advanced.title: Advanced

onComplete.label: On completion
onComplete.auto: Move the issue to the first Done state
onComplete.none: Leave the issue where it is

advanced.tmuxWarningBody: The agent runs in a terminal session on the runner machine that anyone with access to that machine can read and type into.
advanced.reasonLengthHelp: Characters a vote reason must have
advanced.domainsHelp: Bots are always observers in governance decisions
advanced.domainNone: No domain of this project can be added

connection.conflict: Someone else changed this connection. Reload to see the current values.

disableDialog.title: Disable {bot} for {project}?
disableDialog.body: The bot stops receiving tasks for this project and stops voting in it. A task already running continues until it ends.
disableDialog.bodyLast: The bot's token and deliveries are paused until a project enables it again.

rotateDialog.title: Rotate credentials of {bot}?
rotateDialog.body: A new token and signing secret are issued. The current ones stop working at once for every project this bot serves: {projects}. New deliveries wait up to one hour for the runner to use the new configuration.

removeDialog.title: Remove {bot} from {project}?
removeDialog.bodyShared: The bot is no longer an AI participant of this project and its execution settings are deleted. It stays connected to {projects}; its token and runner are unchanged. Votes and task history are kept.
removeDialog.bodyLast: This is the bot's last project. Its token is revoked, its delivery to {address} is deleted and it leaves the workspace. Votes and task history are kept. This cannot be undone.

managed.reason: Change it in the project's Execution settings
